tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ta)༄༅/ /nyams dbyangs chen mo bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bha drā ya/yon tan mtha' dag rgyud la sbyar mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma lha dang dbyer med bzhugs rna
(ta)༄༅/ /nyams dbyangs chen mo bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bha drā ya/yon tan mtha' dag rgyud la sbyar mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma lha dang dbyer med bzhugs rna

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// nyams dbyangs chen mo bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ yon tan mtha' dag rgyud la sbyar mdzad pa'i// bla ma lha dang dbyer med bzhugs rnams la// lus ngag yid gsum dang bas phyag kyang 'tshal// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i mchod pa 'bul// spros bral ngag gi las 'das yid kyis bstod// dus gsum sdig gis mi gos bshags pa byed// dmigs med 'jigs dang bral ba'i skyabs su 'gro// tshad bral dmigs yul spangs pa'i sems bskyed byed// de yi chos nyid rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra// bsags pa med pa'i dge rtsa byang chub bsngo// snang srid stong pa'i maṇḍal 'di bzhes la// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lta ba gtan la 'bebs tsam na// rgyal ba rnams kyi stong pa nyid// lta kun nyes pa 'byung bar gsungs// de phyir lta ba lta rgyu med// shes rab can la lta ba med// blo rnon po la tshig las 'das// brtson 'grus can la bsgom rgyu med// dad pa can la rgyu 'bras med// snying rje can la sems can med// tshogs bsags pa la sangs rgyas med// mtha' bral shes brjod yul las 'das// dbu ma sems tsam la sogs pa// tshig tu brjod pa spros pa yin// yid la sems pa rnam rtog yin// rang bzhin brjod med bsam med yin// ji srid lta ba yod ring la// sdug bsngal kun las mi grol te// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed gsungs// thos pas shes rgyud ma grol bar// lta ba tshig tu ma btang cig /lung dang rigs pa man ngag gi /lta ba thag chod blo re bde// sgom pa nyams len byed tsam na// sgom med sgom pa po yang med// yul med mtha' bral sgom pa de// bya ba thong la nyams su long*// sems med sems kyis sems la ltos// mthong rgyu byung na sems nyid min// mthong med mthong bas sems nyid mthong*// mthong med sems la ma yengs zhog

/chags na gsal bas zin par mdzod// rgod na dran pa'i lcags kyus zung*// gsal la mi rtog sgom pa yin// nyams kyi rtsi yis ma zin par// sgom pa tshig tu ma btang cig /snying rje sems bskyed sngon du btang*// mjug tu dge ba byang chub bsngo// spyod pa nyams su len tsam na// lta sgom nyams su myong ba yin// snang ba'i dngos po rgyas btab nas// blang dor med pa'i spyod pa mdzod// ma bcos shugs 'byung spyod pa de// tshul 'chos phyogs su ma btang cig /grogs su 'gro ba'i spyod pa de// tho co'i phyogs su ma btang cig /'dzin med ro snyoms spyod pa de// chags sdang phyogs su ma btang cig /byar med lhug pa'i spyod pa de// sdig pa'i phyogs su ma btang cig /'khor gsum yang dag spyod pa de// zag bcas dge bar ma btang cig /dge med sdig med spyod pa de// lung ma bstan du ma btang cig /sangs rgyas gtan la 'bebs tsam na// sems las ma gtogs chos rnams med// sems nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas yin// sangs rgyas gzhan du ma btsal zhig /chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan de// gzhi yi phyogs su mi gtang 'tshal// gzugs sku gdul bya'i snang ba la// sangs rgyas ngo bor ma 'dzin cig /gzhi la sangs rgyas med pa la// thob tu re ba mi bgyid 'tshal// don la sems can med pa la// sdug gi dogs pa mi bgyid 'tshal// lta ba bsam brjod med pa la// mdo rgyud thos bsam byas pas 'khrul// sgom pa mtha' dang bral ba la// lus sems rtsol ba byas pas 'khrul// spyod pa shugs 'byung 'gag med de// tshul 'chos tho cor shor bas 'khrul// 'bras bu 'khor 'das dbyer med de// re dogs phyogs su shor bas 'khrul// lta ba dbu ma chen po de// khas len med de ma 'khrul bde// sgom pa lus sems lhug pa de// rtsol sgrub med de ma 'khrul bde// spyod pa chags sdang rgyu gzhi de// blang dor med de ma 'khrul bde// 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po de// re dogs med pas ma 'khrul bde// lta ba spros pa med na yin// sgom pa yengs ba med na yin// spyod pa bya ba thong na yin// 'bras bu sems nyid rtogs na yin// sgro 'dogs chod na lta ba yin// yengs pa med na sgom pa yin// zhen chags med na spyod pa yin// yon tan rdzogs na 'bras bu yin// lar lta ba rtogs pa'i skyes bu la// sgom du ci yang mi gda' na// nyams len med pa'i sgom chen de// spyod pa spyad rgyu mi gda' na// spyod dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor la// 'bras bu ci yang mi gda' na// lta ba med pa lta ba'i mchog

/grub mtha' bde la dgos pa med// sgom du med pa bsgom pa'i mchog /sems 'dzin 'di la dgos pa med// spyod pa med pa spyod pa'i mchog /tshul 'chos 'di la dgos pa med// 'bras bu med pa 'bras bu'i mchog /re dogs 'di la dgos pa med// lar gnas lugs don la mthong rgyu med// da ni lta yang mi lta'o// gnyug ma 'di la bsgom rgyu med// da ni bsgom yang mi bsgom mo// dbyings kyi dang la spyod du med// da ni spyad kyang mi spyad do// lta ba mtha' dbus mi gda' na// nam mkha' yin pa ka snyam bgyid// sgom la g.yo 'gul mi gda' na// ri bo yin pa ka snyam bgyid// nyams la gsal 'grib mi gda' na// nyi zla yin pa ka snyam bgyid// spyod pa blang dor mi gda' na// sa gzhi yin pa ka snyam bgyid// 'bras bu re dogs mi gda' na// zhen log yin pa ka snyam bgyid// lta thog tu sgom pa khel ma khel// lta thog tu sgom pa khel tsam na// gnyug ma'i don la yengs pa med// sgom thog tu lta ba khel ma khel// sgom thog tu lta ba khel tsam na// bsam gtan gyi ro la chags pa med// spyod thog tu lta sgom khel ma khel// spyod thog tu lta sgom khel tsam na// mnyam rjes med pa'i nyams rtogs 'char// sems la rtogs pa ma skyes pa'i// lta ba mtho bas ci la phan// nyon mongs gnyen por ma song bas// sgom la bzang bas ci la phan// shes rab snying rjes ma zin pas// spyod pa zhib pas ci la phan// rang skyon kha yang ma 'bri bas// ye sangs rgyas kyis ci la phan// skye ba med pa'i don rtogs na// lta ba tshad du skyol ba yin// mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis med na// sgom pa tshad du skyol ba yin// tshar gcad rjes gzung snyoms pa na// spyod pa tshad du skyol pa yin// chos sku gzugs sku gnyis thob na// 'bras bu tshad du skyol ba yin// lta ba rang gi sems la dris// rtag chad 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos// sgom pa rang gi sems la dris// yeng ba 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos// spyod pa rang gi sems la dris// tha mal 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos// 'bras bu rang gi sems la dris// dka' thub nus sam mi nus ltos// lta ba sems kyi skyel ma yin// sgom pa sems kyi 'gro lam yin// spyod pa sems kyi grogs po yin// 'bras bu sems kyi sun ma yin// lta ba'i dgung sngon mtho na bzhed// sgom pa'i rgya mtsho zab na bzhed// spyod pa'i zhing sa gshin na bzhed// 'bras bu'i lo tog smin na bzhed// bdag shes rab can yang ma lags te// bla ma mkhas pa bsten pa dang*// thos bsam byas pa'i yon tan gyis// rtogs pa'i go tshul 'di ltar skyes// rgya mtsho'i rus sbal gnya' shing ltar// mi lus thob pa dka' bar go

/'jog po'i gtsug gi nor bu bzhin// bla ma rnyed par dka' bar go /dus bzhi lus kyi 'gyur ba 'di// 'chi ba'i bya gtong yin par go /skyes bu dgra yi yul bton bzhin// thams cad bzhag nas 'gro bar go /rma bya'i mdongs kyi kha dog bzhin// thams cad las las skyes par go /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rtogs na// 'khor bar skye ba med par go /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// snang ba'i rang bzhin stong par go /rmi lam ltad mo mthong ba bzhin// stong pa'i rang bzhin snang bar go /kha chu dwangs pa'i gser bzhin du// rang bzhin rnam par dag par go /sprin dang rnyog ma g.ya' bzhin du// rnam rtog glo bur yin par go /rnam rtog 'khor ba yin par go /rtog med myang 'das yin par go /'khor ba sdug bsngal yin par go /thar pa bde ba yin par go /bde sdug gnyis su med par go /ye stong ye bral yin par go /lar sems la go rtogs shar na bde// lta ba rtogs na yang kyang bde// rnam par smin pa'i sgyu lus bde// na tsha med na yang kyang bde// ri khrod dgon pa brten na bde// bya ba btang na yang kyang bde// chos dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba bde// log 'tsho spangs na yang kyang bde// lus sems gzhon pa'i 'dod yon bde// thabs kyis zin na yang kyang bde// lta spyod mthun pa'i grogs po bde// gcig pur sdod pa'i nyams len bde// zhen chags med pa'i zas nor bde// nges pa med pa'i sdod sa bde// ngo srung bral ba'i mthun 'jug bde// rang dbang rang gis thob na bde// bdag bsod nams can cig ma lags te// mi lus gtsang ma thob pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// mi chos la zhen pa log pa dang*// lha chos la spro ba skyes pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// rang yul spangs nas phyin pa dang*// byes su bla ma mjal ba gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// sde snod la thos pa byas pa dang*// tshig don gnyis ka shes pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// sngags kyi bla ma rnyed pa dang*// dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// snyan brgyud gdams ngag gnang ba dang*// nges shes gting nas skyes pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// rje la mos pa skyes pa dang*// byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// phyi yul sgro 'dogs chod pa dang*// rang byung ye shes shar ba gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// bskyed rim lha ru gsal ba dang*// rdzogs rim nyams su myong ba gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// lus la bde drod 'bar ba dang*// sems la snang stong skyes pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// kun rdzob 'khrul par go ba dang*// don dam stong par shes pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// shes pa yul la shor ba dang*// dran pa'i lcags kyus zin pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// rkyen ngan jag pa byung ba dang*// gnyen po'i ra mdas sleb pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// 'dod pa yul la shor ba dang*// thabs la mkhas pas zin pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// bde sdug nyams su myong ba dang*// de nyid sgyu mar shes pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// sems can sdug bsngal mthong ba dang*// snying rje gting nas skyes pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// rgol ba'i klan ka byung ba dang*// gtan tshigs khong nas shar ba gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// bsod nams chu mig rdol ba dang*// zas nor zhen pa log pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// tshul 'chos spyod pa dor ba dang*// ci dga'i spyod pa byed pa gnyis// de gnyis dus mnyam gcig tu byung*// thos dang shes rab 'dzom yang 'tshal// lung dang rigs par 'dzom yang 'tshal// bla ma brgyud par 'dzom yang 'tshal// gdams ngag nyams len 'dzom yang 'tshal// dad pa brtson 'grus 'dzom yang 'tshal// yon tan grags par 'dzom yang 'tshal// shes rab med pa'i thos pa des// go rtogs skye bar mi gda' na// lung gis ma zin rig pa des// nges shes skye bar mi gda' na// brgyud pa med pa'i bla ma des// byin rlabs 'byung bar mi gda' na// brtson 'grus med pa'i dad pa des// lag tu lon par mi gda' na// nyams len med pa'i gdams ngag des// rang la phan par mi gda' na// grags pa med pa'i yon dan des// gzhan la phan par mi gda' na// sgong med bya de gang nas byung*// bya med sgo nga ci las byung*// bya dang sgo nga gang snga'o// rang bzhin skye ba med pa la// rkyen gyis byed par mi 'dug na// rgyu dang 'bras bu gang snga'o// sems nyid gdod nas dag pa la// rnam rtog ye shes gnyis med na// sangs rgyas sems can gang snga'o// chos rnams ye nas med pa la// 'bras bu sangs rgyas mi 'byung na// chos dang sangs rgyas gang snga'o// don la ci yang med pa la// 'khrul dang ma 'khrul gnyis med na// kun rdzob don dam gang snga'o// don la sangs rgyas med pa la// sde snod gsum po su yis gsungs// ston pas chos 'ga' ma gsungs na// pusti glegs bam ji ltar yin// 'gag pa dngos med shi ba dang*// skye bar 'gyur ba gang thams cad// byas pa don med ces gsungs na// las las 'bras bu cang 'byung ngam// rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa// 'gag par 'gyur ba ji ltar yin// chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i// dngos po gang yang yod pa min// 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid de// skye 'gag yod pa ji ltar yin// chos rnams thams cad brdzun yin na// blo ltos byed pa ji ltar yin// chos rnams thams cad bden yin na// thams cad bslu ba ji ltar yin// 'khor ba sdug bsngal nyid yin na// sdig pa byed pa shin tu 'khrul// mtho ris thar pa med gsungs na// de rgyu dge ba byed pa 'khrul// las 'bras bden pa nyid yin na// rang bzhin stong pa yin pa 'khrul// chu zla nam mkha'i zla ba min// de la ma ltos de snang med// de bzhin dngos po thams cad kyi// rang bzhin bden pa gnyis su gsungs// bden pa gnyis las ma gtogs pa'i// chos de 'thad par mi 'gyur te// rang bzhin bden min brdzun min pas// bden pa gnyis su 'dzin pa 'khrul// 'dod yon sred pa'i cha chu la// ngoms pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// mdze pos me long bltas pa bzhin// zhen pa log na ngoms pa lags// duḥkha chu bo'i gnyer ma la// sangs pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// thabs kyis me bsad du ba bzhin// sdig las log na sangs pa yin// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo las// thar pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// chu la zam pa btsugs pa bzhin// skye med rtogs na thar pa lags// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po la// bskam pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// srid pa'i nyi bdun shar ba bzhin// 'dod sred log na skam pa yin// 'dus byas bya ba'i las dka' la// zin pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// chu dag 'ol kha bsgyur ba bzhin// cog gis bzhag na zin pa lags// gti mug mun pa thibs po la// sangs pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// mun khung nang du sgron me bzhin// ye shes nyi ma shar na sangs// bdag med ye shes nyi ma la// 'char ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na// nyi ma 'char ba'i skya rengs bzhin// chos mchog rgyud la skyes na 'char// rnam rtog nyon mongs zug rngu la// 'byin pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// sman pa mkhas pas mde'u bton bzhin// gnyen po stobs dang ldan na 'byin// bdag 'dzin ser sna'i mdud pa la// grol ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na// dar gyi mdud pa bkrol ba bzhin// longs spyod sgyu mar shes na grol// khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson dong nas// thar pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// btson bu dong nas bton pa bzhin// gzung 'dzin lcags sgrog grol na thar// mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du// phyin pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// 'gron po lam du zhugs pa bzhin// thar pa'i lam sna zin na phyin// bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// mjal ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na// rtag tu ngu dang chos 'phags bzhin// sngon sbyangs las 'phro yod na mjal// gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun la// 'thung ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na// skom pas btung ba rnyed pa bzhin// snod ldan bya ba btang na 'thung*// gnyis med phyag rgya chen po la// rtogs pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// rnga mo bu dang 'phrad pa bzhin// sems ngo shes na rtogs pa lags// tha snyad tshig gi lo ma la// 'dzad pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// ka cha zad pa'i yo lang bzhin// rnam rtog zad na 'dzad pa lags// rang rgyud ko ba gyong po la// thul ba'i dus gcig mi gda' na// chu ser can la klad chu bzhin// chos bzhin byed na thul ba lags// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan la// thob pa'i dus gcig mi gda' na// bsod nams bsags pa'i rgyal srid bzhin// tshogs gnyis rdzogs na thob pa lags// thos bsam byas pa'i grwa pa rnams// mdo rgyud dgongs pa langs lags sam// sgro 'dogs chod pa med nyen che'o// tha snyad phyogs su mi btang 'tshal// zin bshad mdzad pa'i ston pa kun// rang la nges shes bdog lags sam// dam pa'i gdams ngag rtsad chod cig

/mkhas pa tha mal 'chi nyen gda'o// nyams len mdzad pa'i sgom chen kun// bre mo'i las la ma dga' mdzod// lto rgyab gdung ba ma che mdzod// bsam gtan ro la ma chags mdzod// sdig las log pa'i chos pa kun// mdo rgyud lta rtogs bag re mdzod// skabs su bla ma'i chags phyir 'brang*// rtag tu rang gi sems la ltos// dge ba'i phyogs la g.yel ba na// 'chi ba'i 'gyur ba yid la gyis// yul la chags sdang skyes pa na// chos kyi chos nyid yid la gyis// 'khor dang zang zing 'brel pa na// bdud kyi bslu brid shes par gyis// ji ltar byas kyang ma bde na// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs yid la gyis// chos kyis 'di dang phyi mar bde// srid pa bar dor bde ba ste// skye ba phyi mar bde ba yin// skye ba med pas shin tu bde// rang bde gzhan bde gnyis ka bde// de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /mi lus gtsang ma thob dus su// lha chos mi bgyid ji ltar lags// bla ma dam pa bsten bsten nas// mnyes par mi bgyid ji ltar lags// gdams ngag zab mo zhu zhu nas// nyams su mi len ji ltar lags// chos la nges shes skyes skyes nas// slar la ldog pa ji ltar lags// lar rang yul spongs la byes su sdod// yul dang bral yang 'gyod pa med// blo phugs dkar po'i chos la gtod// dmyal bar skyes kyang 'gyod pa med// yi dam gtso bor bla ma bsten// yo byad zad kyang 'gyod pa med// bla ma bsnyen bkur gang yin bya// thugs mi 'dogs kyang 'gyod pa med// lung dang bstun pa'i man ngag zhu// nyams len ma byung 'gyod pa med// dge sbyor gtso bor bya ba thong*// dngos grub ma thob 'gyod pa med// so nam gtso bor dam tshig srungs// grogs kyis khrel yang 'gyod pa med// tshogs bsogs mi tshe chos la skyol// shi bar gyur kyang 'gyod pa med// rang re mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod// gzhan gyis 'phyas kyang 'gyod pa med// grogs la ma dga' gcig pur sdod// nad g.yog med kyang 'gyod pa med// lta rtogs gtso bor sems la ltos// go rtogs chung yang 'gyod pa med// nad dang mthun pa'i kha zas bsten// na tsha byung yang 'gyod pa med// rten dang mthun pa'i spyod pa gyis// tshul 'chos song yang 'gyod pa med// gzhan skyon ma rtog rang skyon rtog

/sha tsha chung yang 'gyod pa med// bsam mno'i gtso bor gzhan phan soms// rang don shor yang 'gyod pa med// nyams dang mthun pa'i glu chung long*// tho cor shor yang 'gyod pa med// yo lang bsris kyi tshod dang sbyor// ston mo ngan yang 'gyod pa med// rgya mtsho'i nang du rdo bskyur bzhin// phyir mi ldog pa'i chos shig 'tshal// tā la'i mgo bo bcad pa bzhin// skye ba med pa'i chos shig 'tshal// mun pa'i tshogs la snang ba bzhin// gnyen por 'gro ba'i chos shig 'tshal// rig byed bram ze'i slob ma bzhin// lung gis zin pa'i chos shig 'tshal// gser la nag tshur btab pa bzhin// grogs su 'gro ba'i chos shig 'tshal// lha khang nang gi sgo srung de// brdeg brdeg 'dra la mi brdeg go /mnga' thang rgyas pa'i khyim pa de// skyid skyid 'dra yang sdug pa yin// dka' thub byed pa'i chos pa de// sdug sdug 'dra yang skyid pa yin// sbyin pa btang ba'i longs spyod de// 'dzad 'dzad 'dra yang 'phel ba yin// sangs rgyas sems can mnyam pa la// skyid sdug khyad re che zhig byung*// bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa la// ched 'dzin khyad re che zhig byung*// dgra dang bu ru mnyam pa la// byams sdang khyad re che zhig byung*// mi lus thob par mnyam pa la// rgyal pham khyad re che zhig byung*// mi lus thob pa'i skyes bu kun// sdig pa'i las la ma dga' mdzod// tshe 'di'i duḥkha mi bzod par// ngan song duḥkha smos ci dgos// dge ba byed pa thams cad la// lta ba bsngo bas zin par mdzod// zag bcas dge bar mi gtang 'tshal// 'khor ba pa la bde ba med// rang la de don mi gnas par// zhal ta byas pa'i ci la phan// tshe 'di'i 'du shes ma log par// chos sgor zhugs pas ci la phan// skye shi'i 'jigs pa med pa la// gdams ngag bstan pas ci la phan// rnam rtog skra lo ma bregs pa'i// mgo spu bregs pas ci la phan// tha mal 'du shes ma bsgyur bar// gos mdog bsgyur bas ci la phan// bla ma dam pa ma bsten par// rang yul spangs pas ci la phan// gdams ngag nyams su ma blangs par// thos bsam byas pas ci la phan// 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa na// chos min phan par mi gda'o// lar 'dod can bla ma g.yo sgyu can// zab mo'i gdams ngag gnang dus med// drang don bslu brid brdzun po che// nges pa'i don dang mjal dus med// 'khor ba'i duḥkha tshan po che// mya ngan 'das pa thob dus med// gti mug mun nag tshabs po che// ye shes nyi ma 'char dus med// sgyu ma lta bu'i don rtogs na// bden tshig rtsad nas chod pa lags// skye ba med pa'i don rtogs na// 'khrul pa rtsad nas chod pa lags// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i don rtogs na// drang don rtsad nas chod pa lags// nam mkha' lta bu'i don rtogs na// nges don rtsad nas chod pa lags// stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs na// rnam rtog rtsad nas chod pa lags// bla ma dam pa'i thugs zin na// gdams
